title: Recommend a Leisure Activity

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Write your own first draft and submit it for feedback.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend recommending a sport or leisure activity. Describe an experience you have had, something you have never tried, the equipment or place needed, and one reason your friend might enjoy it. Use at least six lesson words and include a sentence with a finished past time.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Use four parts: introduce the activity; describe your experience; explain a specific past event; give practical details and invite your friend. Check have / has + past participle and past simple with last year.
